_meta.description: Custom hero data overrides for heroes not in Fribbels or requiring manual corrections
balance_patches: 11/20/2024 - ARavi, Laika, Zio, Ran, Zahhak, Schuri, Hasol
01/08/2026 - Judge Kise, LR Krau, DB Senya, Beehoo, Hwayoung, Landy, MG Lilias, M Bunny Dominiel, Savior Adin, A Mont

S1.name: Strike of Flagbearer
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a flag, with a 75% chance to silence for 1 turn. If the enemy is silenced after the attack, decreases Combat Readiness by 25%.

S2.name: Target Lock
S2.description: After dispelling all buffs from a single enemy, has a 100% chance to inflict Target for 2 turns, and all allies except the caster attack the enemy with a basic skill. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%.

S3.name: Flag of Victory
S3.description: Dispels two buffs from all enemies before a 100% chance to inflict Fear for 2 turns and decrease Combat Readiness by 20%. Grants increased Speed to all allies for 2 turns. At the start of the first battle, grants increased Evasion to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spectral Axe
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe, inflicting injuries proportional to damage dealt (up to 10% of max Health). Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster max Health. A critical hit will heal the caster.

S2.name: War God Might
S2.description: Increases Penetration Resistance by 30%. At the start of the first battle, gains 50 Fighting Spirit. After being attacked, consumes 10 Fighting Spirit, increasing Combat Readiness by 15% and recovering Health proportional to the caster max Health.

S3.name: Deliverance: Soul Exchange
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with divine judgment. When the enemy is defeated, revives one random dead ally to 15% Health and grants skill nullifier once. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster max Health. When an ally dies, grants War God to the caster and resets cooldown of this skill. War God: Increases Defense Penetration by 50%. Dispelled after the effect activates.

S1.name: Tempest
S1.description: Rapidly attacks the enemy, with a 35% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed and penetrates Defense by 20%.

S2.name: Mental Focus
S2.description: Grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns, before granting Skill Nullifier to the caster.

S3.name: Instant Blade
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a sword, dispelling two buffs before a 85% chance (100% when awakened) to inflict Frostbite and Restrict for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Eliminating Variables
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by eliminating unnecessary variables. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster Speed.

S2.name: Laying the Groundwork
S2.description: Confirms the target, with a 100% chance each to dispel two buffs from the enemy and inflict target for 2 turns, before granting increased Attack and immunity to the caster for 2 turns. After using this skill, when the enemy is inflicted with target, grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Eliminating the Target
S3.description: With everything going as planned, attacks all enemies, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. When the target is not an Elite or Boss monster, ignores damage sharing. When the enemy is inflicted with target, penetrates Defense by 80%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster Speed.

S2.name: Supreme Authority
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%, and is immune to Combat Readiness reduction effects. When it is not the caster's turn, when an enemy uses a non-attack skill, decreases their Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Kneel Before Me
S3.description: After dispelling all buffs from all enemies, attacks with dark magic, absorbing 40% of damage dealt as Health.

S1.name: Vulnerability Exposed
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a longsword. Increases Hit Chance and Critical Hit Chance of this skill by 50%. When the target has a buff, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Elaborate Plan
S2.description: Dispels two debuffs from an ally before increasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Grants increased Attack and increased Hit Chance to the caster for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Annihilate
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, penetrating Defense by 100%. This skill does not trigger a counterattack.

S1.name: Rapid Fire
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a pistol. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target max Health. A critical hit will double the amount of Focus gained. Gain 1 Focus.

S2.name: Explosive Gentleman
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. After making a critical hit, increases Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 25%.

S3.name: Rifle Shot
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a rifle and decreases Combat Readiness by 30%. When Focus is full, consumes all, increasing damage dealt and ignoring Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Swift Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, before recovering Health of the caster. Inflicts 500 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the caster max Health. Amount recovered increased.
S1.soulburn_effect: Greatly increases damage dealt. Does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Blade of Vengeance
S2.description: When an ally suffers a counterattack, grants 25% damage reduction. After an enemy counterattacks, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25% and increases additional damage of Swift Cut and Punishing Strike by 1,500. Additional damage increase effect can stack up to 5 times.

S3.name: Punishing Strike
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a secret skill and inflicts 500 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits. Grants increased Defense to all allies for 3 turns, and grants immunity to the caster for 3 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster max Health. After suffering a counterattack, decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

S1.name: Nocturne
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with dark magic, recovering Health. Amount recovered increases proportional to damage dealt.

S2.name: Reign of Terror
S2.description: At the start of battle, gains Focus. When Focus is fully charged, activates End of Evil. After attacking, if the enemy is defeated, resets the cooldown of End of Evil.

S3.name: End of Evil
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with dark magic, with an 85% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. Increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 20%.

S1.name: Light's Judgment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with divine light. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Code Number 00
S2.description: When all allies are attacked at once, has a 50% chance to grant a barrier to all allies for 2 turns. Barrier strength increased.

S3.name: Infinite Horizon
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, dispelling one buff before a 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Dragon's Blessing
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with damage increasing proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Bride's Resolve
S2.description: When an enemy attacks, has a 50% chance to activate Bridal Prayer. Bridal Prayer: Dispels one debuff from the attacked ally and grants a barrier for 3 turns. Gains 10 Souls. When an ally protected by a barrier is attacked, activates Oath of Punishment. Oath of Punishment deals 4000 fixed damage and lasts 3 turns.

S3.name: Overcoming Hardships
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with increased damage. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Penetrates Defense by 100%.

S1.name: Blazing Bullet
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with bullets of flame. Damage increases proportional to the target's lost Health.

S2.name: Flame Keeper
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the start of the caster's turn, grants the caster increased Attack for 2 turns and increases Effectiveness by 30%. When the caster attacks an enemy with Burn, activates Blaze Bullet.

S3.name: Symphony of Radiance
S3.description: Inflicts Burn on all enemies for 2 turns, before increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 25%.

S1.name: Supersonic Kick
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful kick.
S1.soulburn_effect: Grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: Prairie Hawk
S2.description: Increases Evasion by 50%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the turn, grants increased Attack for 1 turn.

S3.name: Monarch's Flaming Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a devastating kick. Defense penetration increases based on the difference between the caster's Attack and the target's Attack (max 100% penetration). Reduced Attack difference required for max penetration.

S1.name: Rapid Fire Cannon
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a cannon. A Critical Hit grants Fighting Spirit.

S2.name: Rampaging Machine
S2.description: When the enemy gains a buff, gains Fighting Spirit. When Fighting Spirit is fully charged, resets the cooldown of Full Blast. After using Full Blast, gains increased Combat Readiness.

S3.name: Full Burst
S3.description: Fires at all enemies to attack, and increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 25%, before granting a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns. When Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to penetrate the target Defense by 50%. This skill cannot trigger a counterattack.

S1.name: Let's Go, Kyla!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with Kyla, recovering Health for all allies. Increased base healing.

S2.name: Elaborate Scheme
S2.description: When an ally except for the caster is attacked, activates Now or Never. Now or Never grants Attack (Greater) to all allies except the caster and increases Combat Readiness of allies by 20%. Grants the caster 50% Combat Readiness.

S3.name: Take the Initiative
S3.description: Attacks the enemy. Grants increased Attack to all allies for 3 turns. When the target is a Hero, ignores damage reduction and damage sharing effects.

S1.name: Bunny Magic
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with bunny magic, with a chance to decrease Combat Readiness.

S2.name: Flow Control
S2.description: When an ally lands a Critical Hit, increases their Combat Readiness by 6%. When the caster's Fighting Spirit is fully charged, activates Flow Control. Flow Control grants Skill Effect Nullifier (1 time) to all allies and increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Divination
S3.description: Grants Vigor to all allies for 2 turns and increases their Combat Readiness by 30%. Recovers the Health of all allies.

S1.name: Decisive Blow
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful strike.

S2.name: Victorious Return
S2.description: When an ally is attacked, counterattacks and gains 10 Souls. When an enemy is defeated, gains 50% Combat Readiness.

S3.name: Light of Salvation
S3.description: Attacks all enemies. Inflicts Extinction when the enemy is defeated. Faith Rune now increases damage against all elements.

S1.name: Water Gun
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a water projectile.

S2.name: Cleansing Light
S2.description: Dispels one debuff from an ally before recovering their Health. Order Rune: 100% chance to dispel.

S3.name: Earnest Prayer
S3.description: Recovers Health of all allies and dispels one debuff. Reduces the caster's skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Health Rune: 25% HP increase.
